section.houseRulesSubtitle: You’ll be staying in someone’s home, so please treat it with care and respect.

html.htmlText:
1. Parties, events and smoking/vaping are prohibited in or around our property.
2. Please check-out on time. Late departures will result in a charge for each additional hour the property cannot be accessed for turnover.
3. Large messes will result in an additional cleaning fee. Please clean up after yourselves and your pets.
4. Firearms and weapons are strictly prohibited on the property.
If any of these house rules are broken, you and your group may be subject to additional charges or be requested to vacate the property immediately without refund.

html.htmlText: Upstay presents this stunning 4-bedroom, family-friendly resort home, located only minutes from Disney at the secure, gated Storey Lake Resort. Entertain friends and family while making a delicious meal in our fully equipped kitchen or relax and unwind pool side after a day of exploring Orlando. Our guests also get access to the fantastic resort facilities including a lazy river, waterslides, and more.

Resort Living, Private Poolside Bliss & Endless Family Fun! This spacious 5-bedroom, 5-bathroom retreat is your ticket to a perfect Florida vacation. Set in a stunning resort community with two luxury clubhouses, this home features a private pool, Jacuzzi hot tub, themed entertainment spaces, and top-tier amenities for the whole crew—just minutes from Disney and Orlando's top attractions.

Sun, Shade & Splash Time
• Private screened-in pool with removable child safety fence
• Jacuzzi hot tub for evening relaxation under the stars
• Furnished patio with loungers & outdoor dining space
• Lush landscaping and tropical vibes throughout

Chill & Play Indoors
• Bright open-concept living space with high ceilings & natural light
• Smart TVs with complimentary Netflix in select rooms
• Cozy electric fireplace for laid-back movie nights
• Upstairs loft area with air hockey table for game time fun

Cook, Dine & Gather
• Fully equipped chef’s kitchen with high-end stainless steel appliances
• Large dining table with seating for 8
• Spacious countertops & full dishware sets—perfect for group meals
• In-home laundry machines for added convenience

Sleep in Comfort
• 5 bedrooms, 6 total beds, 5 full bathrooms
• Two King bedrooms (one with ensuite)
• Bunk bedroom upstairs—perfect for the kids
• Downstairs Queen and Full bedrooms for easy access
• Premium linens, cozy pillows, and plenty of closet space

Resort Perks Included
Your stay includes complimentary access to two exclusive clubhouses—The Hideaway Club and the new Bronson Club. Packed with family-friendly amenities, they offer relaxation and adventure for all ages.

Bronson Clubhouse Amenities:
• Resort-style pool & sun loungers
• Lazy river with floaties
• Onsite bar & grill + indoor lounge
• Pirate-themed kids’ playground
• Fitness room, table tennis, and games room

Hideaway Club Amenities:
• Large family pool + 2 waterslides
• Lazy river & splash pad playground
• Poolside tiki bar, hammocks & sand beach
• 9-hole mini golf & basketball court
• Canoe/kayak rentals from the community dock
• Fitness & business centres + clubhouse lounge
(Note: Some amenities like mini-golf, kayak rentals, spa & food/drink services may incur extra costs)

Unbeatable Location
• 20 minutes to Disney World
• Close to Universal Studios, golf courses, shopping & dining
• Easy access to Orlando International Airport

Why Stay With Us?
This home blends family fun with laid-back luxury. Whether you're floating down the lazy river, grilling on the patio, or enjoying a game night indoors, it’s the ultimate base for unforgettable group getaways. Clean, spacious, and packed with perks—book your stay today and get ready for your best vacation yet!

Parking:
• There's a free onsite parking available in the parking lot next to the house and across from the house on a first-come, first-served basis and guests can park one vehicle. You can also park at the clubhouse but overnight parking is not allowed.

Property Access:
• Guests will enter the community via a locked gate monitored by a security guard.

Resort Access:
• You're provided with complimentary access to the Hideaway Club at Storey Lake!
• Open daily from 9am - 9pm, year-round.

• For a smooth and secure check-in experience, all guests may be required to complete ID and Enso Boarding Pass verification before arrival. Check-in instructions will be shared once verification is completed. Thank you for helping us ensure a seamless stay!
• Please note that pool service is scheduled weekly and may occur during your stay. It's a brief visit to keep the pool clean, and technicians will only access the pool area.

Pet Friendly:
• Pets are welcome at our property. A maximum of two pets under 60 lbs each is permitted. A pet fee of $99 per pet will be added to the reservation when pets are included at the time of booking. If pets are not declared during booking, the applicable fee will be charged separately.

Additional Services:
• Planning a BBQ? A propane tank is available for a one-time $69 charge. Please let us know at least 24 hours in advance so we can have everything ready for you to enjoy the grill.
• Pool is available upon request and are not included in the booking price. The fee is $35/night, with a 2-night minimum. At least 24 hours’ notice is required if you would like to add this service.
• Rent a Pack 'n play for $39 (one-time fee)
• Rent a highchair for $29 (one-time fee)
• We offer mid-stay cleaning for reservations over 3 days in duration. This service is available for an extra fee and will need to be booked in advance.

verifiedHelpModalContent.title: How a listing’s location is verified
verifiedHelpModalContent.body:
A listing’s location is verified after the host submits photos or videos to show their place is where they say it is––and they have access to it.

In some cases, a listing’s location can be verified if guest reviews confirm its location, or the host provides extra documents.

This process has safeguards, but is not a guarantee that every detail on the listing is accurate. Learn about listing location verification

content.localizedStringWithTranslationPreference:
The Hideaway at Storey Lake Resort:
Lakefront with kayak launch and so much more! This resort offers 5 star amenities making it one of the most demanded destinations in the area! 

Storey Lake is located at the corner of State Road (SR535) - also known as Kissimmee-Vineland Road - and Osceola Parkway. This ideal location offers easy access to the Disney World theme parks via W Osceola Pkwy, Epcot Center Dr W (this route has tolls). There is spectacular outlet shopping within minutes from Storey Lake, with a variety of dining establishments and entertainment options!

We get it - travel needs have changed big time. You want a vibe, a neighborhood, a space that feels like home but without the hassle, and that's where we come in.

Since 2019, we’ve manage hundreds of vacation properties, in 4 different countries, and you can expect best-in-class hospitality from us. Before you arrive we’ll email you all you need to know, and our team is here for you day or night, with 24/7 support.

Welcome to Upstay.
